facts.unverified_material_hurdle: NNS component targets; changed NNS metric and denominator

unclassified.reason: Both annual LTI descriptions disclose payout ranges and EPS modifier tiers, but not numerical rTSR or EPS performance thresholds for those tiers. Payout percentages are not performance hurdles; the EPS baseline also differs. Neither event nor strict control can be verified.
Paired annual compensation disclosures give salary and bonus opportunity amounts but no same-tier numerical operating-performance thresholds. These amounts cannot substitute for the required hurdles.

The 2025 program describes financial performance shares based on dividends plus tangible book-value growth and adjusted ROTCE, relative to financial peers, but the reviewed filing does not supply the numerical performance hurdles. Similarity language is not verification of every material hurdle; the 2024 primary filing could not be recovered.

facts.prior_primary_source_status: unavailable via public web directory/index/main attempts

unclassified.reason: The recurring cash plan supplies metric weights and payout caps, not numerical operating-income, cost-saving or service thresholds. A separate one-time PSU grant has published operating-margin hurdles but no comparable prior award, so cannot be used as a relaxation signal.

facts.one_time_PSU_measurement: FY2028 vs FY2025; excludes FedEx Freight

unclassified.reason: The prior/current main filings state structurally consistent ROTCE-based PSU design but do not supply numeric absolute/relative performance thresholds. Higher total compensation is an award amount, not a lower business hurdle.

Both fiscal-year cash plans use threshold/base/stretch revenue levels, but the public exhibits omit those numerical levels. Unchanged payout formulas alone are not a verified unchanged-hurdle control; later proxy disclosures cannot be backdated to this 8-K.

limitations: Zero verified positives means the strict verified manifest cannot support a backtest of this hypothesis; it does not establish that the economic signal never occurs.
Full-source coverage is partial. Unreviewed full filings could contain omitted terms; screened-out supporting texts are not verified unchanged-hurdle controls.

Many performance targets are not numerically published in the contemporaneous 8-K/exhibits. Payout opportunities, award counts, metric weights and formulas are not interchangeable with performance hurdles.
No later proxy or amended filing is backdated. No market outcomes or 2026 filings were examined for these labels.
The 2024 COF primary document could not be recovered via available public web paths. Current COF numeric hurdle levels are also missing.
ADBE metric/denominator changes and PFE measurement-window changes remain excluded/unclassified under the frozen economics; the rules were not loosened to create trades.
